_doc: Recovery pipeline instrument. Every recovery ATTEMPT is recorded with its outcome, earned one trial at a time by fetch -> source-verify -> extract -> round-trip -> rebuild. This REPLACES the forward-scan vocabulary metric (which over-counted: a forward scan cannot tell a genuine synonym gap from by-design composite-specificity). BLOCKED_BY_MATCHER entries, each carrying the exact source string vs the exact registered keyword, ARE the vocabulary measurement -- zero false positives, evidence not guesswork. Outcomes: RECOVERED | REFUSED_ON_SOURCE | BLOCKED_BY_MATCHER | BLOCKED_BY_ACCESS | NOT_FOUND | SCOPE_PENDING.

scoreboard.note: corrections are NOT systematically flattering: of 5 recoveries, 2 tightened and 3 weakened (1 lost significance, 2 moved toward null); 2 refused on source; 1 held on scope. This is the harness getting more honest as the evidence base completes. [+TECOS BLOCKED_BY_ACCESS: abstract 4-point != topic 3-point MACE; 3-point is a paywalled full-text secondary, unverifiable]

attempts.note: MACE primary; source-verified DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2501006. Its abstract used the primary-outcome anchor the matcher scopes out (BLOCKED_BY_MATCHER on 'primary-outcome' hyphen), resolved via verified_effects

population is ACUTE (first-attack) pericarditis, not recurrent; and the audit-cited counts 11/120 vs 25/120 (9.2%/20.8%) appear NOWHERE in the abstract (actual: 20/120 vs 45/120 primary composite). Would have flattered us (0.48 crossing 1 -> 0.47 excluding 1). Refused.

its primary is a FOUR-point composite (adds hospitalization for unstable angina), not the 3-point MACE of this topic; a broad hyphen-matcher fix briefly mispooled it (HR 1.02) as 3-point MACE until corpus-wide before/after showed k=9 not 8. Matcher scoped to exclude the generic anchor; ELIXA stays out.
verified HR 0.82 for MACE, but MACE is a SECONDARY outcome in a kidney-PRIMARY trial and the population is T2D+CKD; needs a protocol-scope decision before integrating. Not integrated.

abstract PRIMARY is a 4-point composite (CV death, MI, stroke, hospitalization for unstable angina), HR 0.98 (0.88-1.09) -- NOT the topic 3-point MACE (ELIXA composite-mismatch class). The 3-point MACE (audit-cited HR 0.99 0.89-1.10) is a full-text SECONDARY; TECOS has no PMC full text (paywalled), so it cannot be source-verified. Corrects the audit over-claim that the abstract reports the 3-point estimand. NOT pooled; needs full-text access to the 3-point secondary.
